segments.sn35.168:1.1: “Yaṃ, bhikkhave, aniccaṃ, tatra vo chando pahātabbo.
segments.sn35.168:1.3: Cakkhu, bhikkhave, aniccaṃ; tatra vo chando pahātabbo … pe … jivhā aniccā;
segments.sn35.168:1.4: tatra vo chando pahātabbo … pe … mano anicco;
segments.sn35.168:1.6: Yaṃ, bhikkhave, aniccaṃ, tatra vo chando pahātabbo”ti.
